test.heading: Monize Test Email
test.body: This is a test email from Monize. If you received this, your email notifications are working correctly.

billReminder.subjectMany: Monize: {{ count }} upcoming bills need attention
billReminder.heading: Upcoming Bill Reminder
billReminder.introOne: You have 1 upcoming bill that needs attention:
billReminder.introMany: You have {{ count }} upcoming bills that need attention:

mortgageReminder.subject: Monize: 1 upcoming mortgage renewal
mortgageReminder.heading: Mortgage Renewal Reminder
mortgageReminder.introOne: You have 1 mortgage with an upcoming term renewal. Contact your lender to discuss renewal options before the term ends:
mortgageReminder.introMany: You have {{ count }} mortgages with an upcoming term renewal. Contact your lender to discuss renewal options before the term ends:

budgetWeeklyDigest.subject: Monize: Your weekly budget summary
budgetWeeklyDigest.heading: Weekly Budget Summary
budgetWeeklyDigest.intro: Here is your weekly budget summary for: {{ budgets }}

budgetMonthlySummary.subject: Monize: Monthly budget summary - {{ period }}
budgetMonthlySummary.subjectPlural: Monize: Monthly budget summary for {{ count }} budgets
budgetMonthlySummary.heading: Monthly Budget Summary
budgetMonthlySummary.intro: Here is your monthly budget summary for the period that just closed:

oidcLink.subject: Monize: Confirm SSO Account Link
oidcLink.heading: Link Your SSO Account
oidcLink.intro: Someone attempted to sign in via SSO with an email that matches your existing Monize account. To link your SSO identity to this account, click the button below:
oidcLink.disclaimer: If you did not initiate this request, you can safely ignore this email. The link expires in 1 hour.

accountLocked.subject: Account Temporarily Locked
accountLocked.heading: Account Temporarily Locked
accountLocked.body1: Your Monize account has been temporarily locked due to multiple failed login attempts. This is a security measure to protect your account.
accountLocked.body2: The lock will expire automatically. If you did not attempt to log in, we recommend resetting your password immediately.

passwordReset.subject: Monize Password Reset
passwordReset.heading: Password Reset Request
passwordReset.intro: We received a request to reset your password. Click the button below to set a new password:
passwordReset.disclaimer: This link will expire in 1 hour. If you did not request a password reset, you can safely ignore this email.

emailVerification.subject: Verify your Monize email
emailVerification.heading: Verify your email address
emailVerification.intro: Thanks for signing up for Monize. Please confirm your email address to activate your account and sign in:
emailVerification.disclaimer: This link will expire in 24 hours. If you did not create a Monize account, you can safely ignore this email.

accountInvite.subject: Your Monize account is ready
accountInvite.heading: Your Monize account is ready
accountInvite.intro: An administrator has created a Monize account for you. Click the button below to set your password and sign in:
accountInvite.disclaimer: This link will expire in 24 hours. If you were not expecting this, you can safely ignore this email.

delegateInvite.subject: You have been invited to Monize
delegateInvite.heading: You have been invited to Monize
delegateInvite.intro: {{ owner }} has invited you to access their Monize account as a delegate. Click the button below to set your password and get started:
delegateInvite.disclaimer: This link will expire in 24 hours. If you were not expecting this invitation, you can safely ignore this email.

emergencyAccessReminder.subjectOne: Monize: your account has been inactive for 1 day
emergencyAccessReminder.subjectMany: Monize: your account has been inactive for {{ daysSinceLogin }} days
emergencyAccessReminder.heading: Monize Emergency Access Reminder
emergencyAccessReminder.bodyOne: You have not signed in to Monize for 1 day. If you remain inactive, your designated emergency contacts will be granted full access to your account {{ grantPhrase }}.
emergencyAccessReminder.bodyMany: You have not signed in to Monize for {{ daysSinceLogin }} days. If you remain inactive, your designated emergency contacts will be granted full access to your account {{ grantPhrase }}.
emergencyAccessReminder.footer: Signing in resets the timer. If you no longer want this feature enabled, you can disable it from Settings → Emergency Access.

emergencyAccessGrant.subject: You have been granted emergency access to {{ owner }}'s Monize account
emergencyAccessGrant.heading: Emergency Access Granted
emergencyAccessGrant.body: {{ owner }} previously designated you as an emergency contact on their Monize account. Because they have not signed in for an extended period, you are now being granted full access to take over the account.
emergencyAccessGrant.claimIntro: To claim access, click the link below and set a new password. You will be signed in as the account holder.
emergencyAccessGrant.expiry: This link is valid until {{ expiry }} and can only be used once. If multiple contacts received this email, the first to claim will take over the account.

emergencyAccessGrantRevoked.subject: Monize: emergency access was granted while you were away
emergencyAccessGrantRevoked.heading: Emergency Access Was Granted While You Were Away
emergencyAccessGrantRevoked.body1: Because your account had been inactive, your designated emergency contacts were sent links to take over your account. You have now signed back in, so those links have been revoked and the safeguard has been re-armed.
emergencyAccessGrantRevoked.body2: If this was expected, no action is needed. If you did not expect this, review your sign-in activity and your emergency-access settings.

providerOutage.subject: Monize: {{ provider }} is not responding
providerOutage.heading: Market data provider unavailable
providerOutage.intro: Monize has not been able to reach {{ provider }} since {{ since }} ({{ duration }}). Requests to it are suspended for now and retried at widening intervals.
providerOutage.impact: Prices, charts and index comparisons that depend on this provider may be missing or out of date until it answers again. Nothing recorded in Monize has been lost.
providerOutage.whatToCheck: If the provider itself is up, check this server's outbound network access and DNS -- a container that cannot resolve or reach the provider fails exactly this way.
providerOutage.throttleNote: You will get one more email when it recovers. Alerts about the same provider are sent at most once every {{ hours }} hours, so a provider that keeps flapping cannot fill your inbox.

providerRecovery.subject: Monize: {{ provider }} is answering again
providerRecovery.heading: Market data provider is answering again
providerRecovery.intro: {{ provider }} answered again at {{ restoredAt }}. The outage lasted {{ duration }}.
providerRecovery.backfill: Prices and index history missed during the outage are picked up by the next scheduled refresh; no action is needed.

systemAlert.subject: Monize: {{ title }}
systemAlert.heading: System alert
systemAlert.intro: An issue on your Monize deployment needs an administrator's attention.
systemAlert.footer: This alert is also shown in the app's notification bell. It is raised at most once per occurrence, however many server replicas noticed it.

notificationImmediate.subject: You have a new Monize notification
notificationImmediate.footer: You are receiving this because immediate email is on for this notification type. Change it in Settings, Notifications.

gemSignal.allocationMessage: Your GEM strategy "{{ strategy }}" now targets {{ target }}. Open to review the recommendation.
gemSignal.allocationMessageUnknown: Your GEM strategy "{{ strategy }}" changed its target. Open to review the recommendation.

portfolioMovement.messageDown: Your investments are down {{ percent }}% today, excluding deposits and withdrawals. Open to review.

balanceThreshold.messageHigh: {{ account }} rose to {{ balance }}, above your {{ threshold }} threshold.

backupFailed.message: The automatic backup for {{ user }} failed: {{ error }}

backupPartial.messageRetention: The backup for {{ user }} succeeded, but old backup files could not be cleaned up: {{ error }}

encryptionKeyMissing.title: Encryption key not configured
encryptionKeyMissing.message: ENCRYPTION_KEY is not set, so backups are written unencrypted and secrets cannot be stored. A future release will refuse to start without it.

smtpFailure.title: Email delivery is failing
smtpFailure.message: Monize could not send email: {{ error }}. Notifications and reminders are not being delivered.

providerOutage.title: {{ provider }} is not responding
providerOutage.message: Market data from {{ provider }} is unavailable. Prices and index data may be out of date until it answers again.

providerRecovered.title: {{ provider }} is answering again
providerRecovered.message: The outage is over and market data from {{ provider }} is updating again.

scheduledPostFailed.message: Your scheduled transaction due {{ date }} did not post automatically: {{ error }}. You can post it manually from Bills.

budget.overMessage: You have spent {{ amount }} of your {{ limit }} budget for {{ category }} ({{ percent }}%).
budget.thresholdMessage: You have used {{ percent }}% of your {{ category }} budget ({{ amount }} of {{ limit }}).
budget.projectedMessage: At your current pace, {{ category }} is projected to reach {{ projected }} by the end of the period (budget: {{ budgeted }}).
budget.flexMessage: The "{{ group }}" flex group has used {{ spent }} of its combined {{ budgeted }} budget ({{ percent }}%).
budget.incomeMessage: Your actual income ({{ actual }}) is at {{ ratio }}% of expected income ({{ expected }}) at this point in the period.
budget.milestoneMessage: You are {{ progress }}% through the period and have only used {{ percent }}% of your total budget. Keep it up!
budget.seasonalMessage: Last {{ month }} you spent {{ increase }}x your usual on {{ category }}. Consider adjusting your budget.

priceMovement.message: {{ symbol }}: {{ percent }}% compared with the previous available session.

backupOffsite.copyIntro: This is the automatic {{ tier }} backup of your Monize account for {{ date }}. The file is attached to this email.
backupOffsite.copyEncrypted: The attachment is encrypted with your Monize backup password. It cannot be opened without that password, and Monize cannot recover it for you -- keep the password somewhere other than this mailbox.
backupOffsite.copyRestore: To restore it, open Monize, go to Settings, Backup & Restore, upload this file and enter your backup password.
backupOffsite.copyVerify: The SHA-256 above is of the attached bytes, so you can check later that the copy you kept is the one this email delivered.
backupOffsite.tooLargeSubject: Monize backup {{ filename }} was too large to email
backupOffsite.tooLargeHeading: Your Monize backup was not emailed
backupOffsite.tooLargeIntro: Today's backup is {{ size }}, which is over the {{ limit }} this deployment allows for an emailed backup (BACKUP_EMAIL_MAX_BYTES).
backupOffsite.tooLargeNoBytes: Nothing was attached to this email, and no download link is offered -- a link would need a credential that could read your backups back out of storage, which this feature does not hold.
backupOffsite.tooLargeUnaffected: The backup itself was written normally. The copy on this server is unaffected, and so is the copy on your S3 destination if you have one enabled.
backupOffsite.tooLargeWhatToDo: To keep an off-machine copy of a backup this size, download it from Settings, Backup & Restore, enable the S3 destination, or ask your administrator to raise the email limit.
